input_decoder.source:
(import (chezscheme))
(define (maze-mark? value) (or (eq? value '_) (eq? value '*)))
(define (maze-row? value) (and (list? value) (for-all maze-mark? value)))
(define (maze-grid? value) (and (list? value) (for-all maze-row? value)))
(define (maze-expected-kind value)
  (cond ((eq? value #f) 0) ((eq? value 'error) 1)
        ((maze-grid? value) 2) (else 3)))
(define (emit value) (display value) (newline))
(define (read-i64)
  (let ((value (read)))
    (unless (and (integer? value) (exact? value) (<= (- (expt 2 63)) value (- (expt 2 63) 1)))
      (error 'mazefun "expected an exact signed 64-bit input" value))
    (emit value)))
(read-i64) (read-i64) (read-i64)
(let* ((value (read)) (kind (maze-expected-kind value)))
  (when (eof-object? value) (error 'mazefun "missing expected datum"))
  (emit kind)
  (when (= kind 2)
    (emit (length value))
    (for-each (lambda (row)
                (emit (length row))
                (for-each (lambda (mark) (emit (if (eq? mark '_) 1 0))) row)) value)))

rust.name: mazefun
rust.setup_excluded: Process startup, Wasm compilation/instantiation and complete input decoding. No cave/maze or expected-grid reconstruction is placed outside repetitions.
rust.predicate_boundary: Initial false after start; all maze work and intermediate/previous-result cleanup timed. Direct complete Datum/grid kind/shape/length/mark comparison precedes stopped-clock capture. Full result/CSV printing and final result cleanup follow capture. Rejection has no stopped clock or normal output.
rust.timed: Exactly10000 complete11×11 functional reconstructions, original shuffle/removal/duplicate/flood order and complete final supplied predicate.

correctness.predicate: Exact false/error/full-grid result kind and value. Canonical grid compares all11 rows and121 exact Atom symbol marks, with both list exhaustion checks.

rust.representation: Persistent Rc cave/shuffle/result chains; inline Option<usize-coordinate> labels and char marks; Vec temporary neighbor/ID/hole/output storage. Original coordinate/neighbor/ID/concat/size-pair objects and strict I64/product/variant layouts differ.
rust.ownership: Last-owner intermediate/vector/cave/shuffle cleanup occurs within invocations; prior result top-level releasesN-1 inside timer; final result release follows stopped clock and prints. Scheme collection/reclamation and liveness schedules differ.
rust.control_semantics: Increasing final matrix/candidate order, original deterministic LCG/removal and up/down/left/right neighbors; duplicate-label rejection, updated-cave old-label reads, incoming-cave flood neighbors and pierce-after-flood order. Pure initial matrix callbacks execute in reverse under Rust iterator.rev; allocation/evaluation schedule parity not claimed.
rust.opacity: Original input-dimension/result black_box boundaries only; no kernel barriers, caching or shortened input. Observer is separate.
rust.domain_limits: Canonical boolean/symbol/proper-list syntax and signed decimal i64 count/dimensions; manageable Wasm32 indexing/storage. Alternate boolean/numeric syntax, escaped boolean/numeric-like symbols, proper lists spelled with dotted tails, malformed trailing input and huge/exceptional stack/resource/abort cleanup equivalence are outside this reader/domain claim. Residual observer function/site counts are not total constructors, V8 physical allocations, native instructions or clean timings.

protocol.environment_limit: Remaining environment inherited; full values not archived.
protocol.workload_clock: Program/host clock excludes setup and includes complete final predicate.
protocol.process_clock: Parent monotonic launch-through-completion; distinct from workload clock.
